lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular maxima organized into approximate vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a multi-row horizontal matrix across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a checkerboard-like grid of anchor points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular notch on the trailing posterior edge of the visible pectoral fin.
